name: tish-apple
description: Apple-platform UI hosts for Tish (macOS AppKit + iOS UIKit)

scripts.clean: find . -type d \( -name dist -o -name target -o -name node_modules -o -name .derivedData \) -prune -print0 | xargs -0 rm -rf
scripts.example:hello-ios: npm --prefix examples/hello-ios install && npm --prefix examples/hello-ios run run
scripts.example:hello-ios:build: npm --prefix examples/hello-ios install && npm --prefix examples/hello-ios run build && npm --prefix examples/hello-ios run xcodebuild:sim
